samples.summary: Unguarded `localStorage.getItem` in `getDateFormat` is called as the `useSyncExternalStore` snapshot on every render of the documents list and Settings page; a storage SecurityError takes the whole list down
samples.evidence: `getDateFormat()` (line 31-34) does a bare `localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)` and is passed directly as `getSnapshot` to `useSyncExternalStore` (line 56), so it runs on every render of `DateCell` (document-list.tsx:241) and of Settings (page.tsx:26). Accessing `localStorage` throws outright (SecurityError) in Safari private mode, with third‑party/blocked storage, and in sandboxed iframes — the repo already knows this and guards every other such read: `board-grid.ts:220-228` (`try { localStorage.getItem } catch { return DEFAULT }`), `font-recents.ts:23-26`, `analytics.ts:47-53`. Here the throw happens during render, so instead of falling back to `DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT` it propagates and blanks the entire document list — the exact failure mode the surrounding date-parsing guards were written to avoid.

samples.summary: Unguarded `localStorage.setItem` in `setDateFormat` throws out of the Select's `onValueChange`, so the preference silently fails to apply instead of degrading
samples.evidence: `setDateFormat` (line 37-40) writes without a try/catch and dispatches the change event only after the write. If `setItem` throws (quota exceeded, blocked/partitioned storage, private mode) the exception escapes `onValueChange={(value) => setDateFormat(value as DateDisplayFormat)}` (settings/page.tsx:71), the `CHANGE_EVENT` is never dispatched, and subscribers never update — the user's click appears to do nothing. `board-grid.ts:230-236` and `font-recents.ts` wrap the equivalent write in try/catch precisely so a lost view preference cannot break the UI.

samples.summary: `value as DateDisplayFormat` bypasses the module's own `isFormat` validator, so an unexpected value (e.g. an empty string from Radix) is persisted and then silently reverts
samples.evidence: `date-format-preference.ts` has a runtime validator (`isFormat`, line 26) but only uses it on read. The Settings handler casts the raw string from Radix (`setDateFormat(value as DateDisplayFormat)`) with no validation. Radix Select can emit `""` when a value is cleared; that string is written to localStorage, `getDateFormat()` then falls back to `"relative"`, and the controlled `value={dateFormat}` disagrees with what was just stored — a state inconsistency that a `isFormat(value)` check in `setDateFormat` would make impossible.

samples.summary: The 7-day-old sample date makes the "Exact date" example include a year during the first week of January, contradicting the adjacent comment
samples.evidence: `sample = now - 7 days`; `formatExactDate` omits the year only when `date.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()` (document-list-utils.ts:116). Between Jan 1 and Jan 7 the sample falls in the previous calendar year, so the option reads "Exact date (Dec 29, 2025)" rather than the same-year "Jul 25" the comment on lines 32-33 promises. Cosmetic only, but the example then illustrates the less common formatting.

verdict.reason: The finding verifies precisely as described. `date-format-preference.ts:32` performs a bare `localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)` with no try/catch and no window/typeof guard, and `getDateFormat` is passed directly as the client `getSnapshot` to `useSyncExternalStore` at line 56 — the `() => DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT` third argument is only `getServerSnapshot` (SSR/hydration) and does not catch a client-side throw. The hook runs during render at `document-list.tsx:241` inside `DateCell`, which is instantiated per row by the column cell renderer at `document-list.tsx:269`, and at `settings/page.tsx:26`. A SecurityError from storage access therefore propagates out of render rather than falling back to DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT, blanking the documents list. The repository itself treats this failure mode as real and guards every comparable read: `board-grid.ts:220-228` ("Storage can throw outright in private mode / with cookies blocked"), `analytics.ts:47-57` (explicit SecurityError comment), `notes-settings.ts:12-19`, `slides-view.tsx:295-300`, plus a dedicated test at `board-grid.test.ts:201`; `theme-provider.tsx:107` branches on `isIframe`, confirming iframe embedding is a supported deployment. No upstream guard, shim, or wrapper makes the path unreachable — and the other unguarded read at `theme-provider.tsx:41` is bypassed by the `?theme=` early return at line 40, so it cannot be claimed that something else always fails first. `setDateFormat`'s unguarded `localStorage.setItem` at line 38 (reached from `settings/page.tsx:71`) is the same defect class. Uncaught throw on a real render path = critical under the Correctness rubric; no refutation ground applies.
